source: Many times, my congregation has asked me; "What is the greatest teaching of the Shepherd, Father?"
...That you may tread on green hills...
...Such is the path of the flame...
I'd say I'll miss you, but I already do.
[Remember his voice]
...Soar in the blue sky...
...Such is the path of all living...
But just in case you don't know...
[Imagine his face]
...And dive in a deep and boundless sea.
...As is your command and your name.
...I'll miss you.
[Remember his spirit]
Now, a moment to bask in the light of the Flame...
We thank you, Shepherd. And we thank you, oh Great Apes, who in His absence spread His word and will. Our faith is our flame, our light and our warmth. Thank you.
[End]
Each time, I give them the same answer.
"Rebirth," I say. That which once was old, will be young. That which was frail, will be strong. That which was dying, will live.
But, I tell them, it will not be life as they know it. No nights, nor days, no rain, or storms. No streets, nor houses.
(AMBITIOUS) ...Nothing fun at all, in fact...
(CUNNING) ...No vague sermons from priests...
(POWERFUL) ...No boundaries, no limits...
...Such is the path of the Shepherd, such is the path of the flame...
...Hope you can't hear this, Grandpa...
A dance, eternal - so that we, like He did, may walk through green hills, fly through the blue sky, and dive in the deep sea.
Is that what you're doing now, Grandpa?
...Such is the path of the Shepherd, such is the path of the flame...
...I wonder what you'd have to say, if you were here...
Clarence Bloodworth was a steadfast pillar of the City. All who knew him would say so. A man most reliable. Unwaveringly, he offered advice, and tirelessly, he saw to the work that needed doing.
Yeah. You were reliable.
No. The best part about you was your sense of humour.
More than anything, you were caring.
It takes a certain Kind to grow so influential and so respected, while remaining as modest as he did. He knew, my herd, that the Blood of the Shepherd came first.
They wasted too much of your time, Grandpa.
Family came first. Not the Apes.
A strong man is he who knows his place in the herd. And none were stronger than Clarence.
You hear that, Grandpa? No one.
...What am I doing wrong, Grandpa? Why can't I find my place?
I'll do you proud. I promise.
Today, Clarence Bloodworth, in the presence of your loved ones, we shall burn your remains. Today, we set you free. May the flame of the Shepherd release you...
...Such is the path of the Shepherd...
I guess this is it, Grandpa.
[Close your eyes]
